# v26.0 WP10: Region-scoped start effects (BYZ/ROM compatible, two-tier origin, renewable 30y waves).
# Generated by gen_v260_cul_rel_overhaul.py; edit the generator, not this file.
oe_rw_start_egypt_romanization = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_rw_start_egypt_romanization_allowed = yes }
        region:egypt_region = {
            ordered_location_in_region = {
                limit = { oe_rw_egypt_origin_ge25 = yes }
                max = 1
                check_range_bounds = no
                order_by = {
                    value = population
                    multiply = oe_rw_assim_egypt_source_share
                    if = { limit = { oe_rw_egypt_origin_ge50 = yes } add = 10000000 }
                    if = { limit = { this = location:alexandria } add = 1000000 }
                    if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes } } add = 100000000 }
                }
                # Clear any dead 0-location movement remnants before spawning.
                culture:oe_egypt_greek_culture = {
                    every_movement_in_culture = {
                        limit = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_egypt_identity_movement num_locations_affected = 0 }
                        destroy_movement = yes
                    }
                }
                save_scope_as = oe_rw_origin_loc
                spawn_movement = {
                    movement_definition = movement_definition:oe_egypt_identity_movement
                    supporters = { value = population multiply = oe_rw_assim_egypt_source_share multiply = 0.1 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        culture:oe_egypt_greek_culture = {
                            any_movement_in_culture = {
                                movement_type = movement_definition:oe_egypt_identity_movement
                                num_locations_affected > 0
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM }
                        c:ROM = {
                            set_variable = oe_rw_egypt_romanization_started
                            set_variable = { name = oe_rw_origin_egypt value = scope:oe_rw_origin_loc }
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
                        c:BYZ = {
                            set_variable = oe_rw_egypt_romanization_started
                            set_variable = { name = oe_rw_origin_egypt value = scope:oe_rw_origin_loc }
                        }
                    }
                    culture:oe_egypt_greek_culture = {
                        remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                        remove_variable = oe_identity_start_expired
                    }
                    oe_identity_schedule_30_years = { holder = culture:oe_egypt_greek_culture event = oe_identity_expiry.6 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

                culture:oe_latin_greek_culture = {
                    every_movement_in_culture = {
                        limit = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_latin_identity_movement num_locations_affected = 0 }
                        destroy_movement = yes
                    }
                }
                save_scope_as = oe_rw_origin_loc
                spawn_movement = {
                    movement_definition = movement_definition:oe_latin_identity_movement
                    supporters = { value = population multiply = oe_rw_assim_latin_source_share multiply = 0.1 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        culture:oe_latin_greek_culture = {
                            any_movement_in_culture = {
                                movement_type = movement_definition:oe_latin_identity_movement
                                num_locations_affected > 0
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM }
                        c:ROM = {
                            set_variable = oe_rw_latin_romanization_started
                            set_variable = { name = oe_rw_origin_latin value = scope:oe_rw_origin_loc }
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
                        c:BYZ = {
                            set_variable = oe_rw_latin_romanization_started
                            set_variable = { name = oe_rw_origin_latin value = scope:oe_rw_origin_loc }
                        }
                    }
                    culture:oe_latin_greek_culture = {
                        remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                        remove_variable = oe_identity_start_expired
                    }
                    oe_identity_schedule_30_years = { holder = culture:oe_latin_greek_culture event = oe_identity_expiry.11 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_rw_start_german_romanization = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_rw_start_german_romanization_allowed = yes }
        region:north_german_region = {
            every_location_in_region = {
                limit = { oe_rw_german_origin_ge25 = yes }
                add_to_temporary_list = oe_rw_german_candidates
            }
        }
        region:south_german_region = {
            every_location_in_region = {
                limit = { oe_rw_german_origin_ge25 = yes }
                add_to_temporary_list = oe_rw_german_candidates
            }
        }
        ordered_in_list = {
            list = oe_rw_german_candidates
            max = 1
            check_range_bounds = no
            order_by = {
                value = population
                multiply = oe_rw_assim_german_source_share
                if = { limit = { oe_rw_german_origin_ge50 = yes } add = 10000000 }
                if = { limit = { this = location:vienna } add = 1000000 }
                if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes } } add = 100000000 }
            }
            # Clear any dead 0-location movement remnants before spawning.
            culture:oe_german_greek_culture = {
                every_movement_in_culture = {
                    limit = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_german_identity_movement num_locations_affected = 0 }
                    destroy_movement = yes
                }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_rw_origin_loc
            spawn_movement = {
                movement_definition = movement_definition:oe_german_identity_movement
                supporters = { value = population multiply = oe_rw_assim_german_source_share multiply = 0.1 }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    culture:oe_german_greek_culture = {
                        any_movement_in_culture = {
                            movement_type = movement_definition:oe_german_identity_movement
                            num_locations_affected > 0
                        }
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { country_exists = c:ROM }
                    c:ROM = {
                        set_variable = oe_rw_german_romanization_started
                        set_variable = { name = oe_rw_origin_german value = scope:oe_rw_origin_loc }
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
                    c:BYZ = {
                        set_variable = oe_rw_german_romanization_started
                        set_variable = { name = oe_rw_origin_german value = scope:oe_rw_origin_loc }
                    }
                }
                culture:oe_german_greek_culture = {
                    remove_variable = oe_identity_wave_cd
                    remove_variable = oe_identity_start_expired
                }
                oe_identity_schedule_30_years = { holder = culture:oe_german_greek_culture event = oe_identity_expiry.8 }
            }
        }
    }
}
